sec07-EFFECTIVE | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at A/A.01 | No effective date is established by the revision label; retain the accepted effective-date disposition.
sec07-BANK | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at A/A.01 | No total knowledge-test question-bank size has been verified.
sec07-CITY-URBAN-LEAD | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 56 L27-29 gives city searching as two blocks/signals and urban searching as three blocks/signals without distinguishing city from urban. Neither number is taught as a universal urban rule; highway quarter-mile and 20-30-second visual-lead guidance are separately supported.
sec07-HYDROPLANING-THRESHOLDS | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 60 L10-16 describes stable wet traction around 30 mph, rising on pooled water above 35 mph, total loss in heavy rain at 45-50 mph, and worn-tire loss at 25-30 mph. These are not established universal safe-speed or onset thresholds; retain all values for issuer clarification, with slowing on wet roads supported.
sec07-SAME-SPEED-ABSOLUTE | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 60 L18-20 says same-direction vehicles at equal speeds with adequate spacing cannot hit one another. It omits changing conditions; do not teach this as a guarantee.
sec07-MERGE-GAP-CONSISTENCY | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 58 L20-22 specifies a 4-5-second lane-change gap. Page 64 L29-35 and the page-72 answer key specify 4-6 seconds. Page 64 says moving into the middle enables both vehicles to adjust to three seconds, which is not guaranteed by a four-second gap. Preserve both ranges and the adjustment claim as unresolved; no unified numeric gap is invented.
sec07-SPLIT-PAGE-ROAD-LIMITS | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | The outside-town and otherwise-unposted normal-condition heading is on page 61 L39-45; page 62 L3-6 continues with 75 mph on separated multilane highways designated and posted by the Secretary, 65 mph State/Federal highways, and 55 mph county/township highways. Complete conditions span pages. Under the single-page fact contract these class defaults remain debt rather than unqualified legal rules.
sec07-EMERGENCY-DISTANCE-JURISDICTION | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 63 L37-42 says many states require 500 feet behind emergency equipment and gives minimum 12 seconds at 30 mph or six seconds at 60 mph. It does not establish a Kansas-specific 500-foot law; no such Kansas legal threshold is taught.
sec07-HORN-SCOPE | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 68 L11-22 recommends light taps in ordinary conflict-warning situations and sharp blasts for danger, but L23-28 limits horn use to emergencies. The broad ordinary-use versus emergency-only distinction needs clarification; listed non-warning uses and danger warnings remain supported.
sec07-SIGNAL-TIMING | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 69 L18-21 gives urban 100 feet or 3-5 seconds and above-40-mph 200 feet or 3-5 seconds; L39-41 gives at least 3-4 seconds. Do not substitute one precise universal signaling threshold or claim these are equivalent at every speed.
sec07-LEFT-TURN-STAGING | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 57 L32-36 directs pulling into an intersection for a left turn without restating a signal or clear-path condition; page 47 L6-12 mentions green. The unconditional staging instruction is withheld; safe-gap and unobstructed-path requirements are supported.
sec07-LICENSE-ABSOLUTE | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 70 L25-26 says a license is needed for any vehicle on a public highway or parking facility, without the exemptions described earlier in the handbook. Do not use it as an exceptionless licensing rule.
sec07-SIGNAL-ILLUSTRATION | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | The page-69 L22-28 A/B vehicle example refers to a previous-page illustration. Relative geometry and vehicle-specific interpretation are not established by the extracted text alone; the visual example remains debt.
sec-SAFE-MARKET | source_missing | owner SMEResearchAgent | tier reputable | at E/E.01 | Demand, seasonality, prices, pass rates, buyer profiles, voice of customer and ad hooks for Kansas Safe driving have not been researched.
sec-SAFE-TEARDOWN | source_missing | owner SMEResearchAgent | tier reputable | at E2/E2.01 | Kansas competitor evidence for Safe driving has not been gathered.
